newsitem.title: USA: Old Dominion sees rev growth 15-20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Old Dominion sees rev growth 15-20 pct.

text.p: Old Dominion Freight Line Inc said Thursday it expects to post revenue growth of between 15 percent and 20 percent by the end of the year.
The company said it expects to add 45 sales representatives in targeted areas.

Old Dominion, which primarily transports general commodities from multiple shippers in a single truckload, said it is looking to build market share in existing markets and improve operating efficiencies.
It also plans to expand geographically on a limited basis.

In first quarter results issued Thursday, Old Dominion reported net income of $1.4 million, or $0.17 per share, on revenues of $73.59 million. In the prior year's first quarter, the company reported net income of $657,000, or $0.08 per share, on revenues of $68.26 million.
